concerns.text: Layout‑preservation metrics (Masked SSIM, Edge Alignment Score, Keypoint Matching Score) are computed between the edited image and the *baseline reconstruction* (decode(encode(z_doc))). Since both images pass through the same VAE decoder, the validation target is not independent of the decoder (a core component of the predictor). This creates a circular validation where decoder artifacts cancel out, potentially inflating layout‑preservation scores and undermining the claim that editing preserves layout.

FR‑003 specifies an *unsupervised* K‑Means clustering on unlabeled crops, yet Phase 6 performs a supervised Linear SVM classification on latent vectors. This mismatch violates the functional requirement and may bias the disentanglement assessment, as supervised training uses the same modality labels that are later used for evaluation.
